spans.tib: de las nyams pa sor ma chud gyi bar du
spans.eng: during the period between losing his result and gaining it back again

spans.nul: The final sentence gives the reason, but GMR supplies no separate because.

segments.note:
PROVISIONAL fresh Codex reconciliation of preserved historical Tibetan-first and English-first proposals. The contracted locative coordination 'dod rtser is kept at d=3 as "in the desire realm or "peak" level", not as a new dictionary compound. The two experience categories remain phrases: skyes nas myong 'gyur carries the next-life category, including GMR's repeated explanation "subsequent to a rebirth, for either his next life"; lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur carries "for any life beyond", with the experience predicate shared across the English coordination. The latter phrase is elliptical, not evidence that myong means "life" or has no meaning.

The complete temporal phrase de las nyams pa sor ma chud gyi bar du corresponds to "during the period between losing his result and gaining it back again". Until the lost result is restored and the interval ending in restoration express the same temporal boundary. This retains the negative construction without falsely nulling sor ma chud or banking it alone as the positive "gaining". The demonstrative de after the unstable realized being is resumed as "he" in the next English sentence. The adnominal gyi is expressed through relative "which"; the overt copula yin owns "is". min owns the negative "Neither" at grammatical depth; additive yang has no separate word outside that negative continuation.

English order selects the correct repeated desire/realm/peak/result occurrences. The approved negative-affix members in "unstable" and "impossible" remain inside their genuine compounds. Unpaired Tibetan is limited to genitive suffixes and punctuation; supplied English framing remains outside lexical spans. The appended "56 Projections with Different Realms and Beings, Continued" is the registered following-heading class. No wording or hgm_gloss was changed, and no new erratum is proposed.

segments.title: twenty-two projections in the desire realm

spans.tib: de ni mthong chos 'bras bu yin
spans.eng: One is the type with results that you see

spans.nul: Topic marker; no separate English topic word.

segments.note:
PROVISIONAL fresh Codex reconciliation of two independent fresh Codex proposals. The first de is retained within its actual clause, de ni mthong chos 'bras bu yin to "One is the type with results that you see" at d=2. C05:178 explains the referent as the one group of eleven definite cases. This is not a dictionary claim that the demonstrative de means the numeral "One", and the demonstrative is not omitted or falsely nulled. The result expression stays out of the dictionary harvest because its relative-clause wording is distributed.

The second de directly owns "It". kho na owns exclusive "but" in "but a single", the sense of "only", not an adversative; it remains a grammatical particle at d=6. rigs is the category noun behind "discrete type". The current HGM entry has both "discrete" and "type", and C05:178 expands this same statement through ris mthun gcig kho na and "but a single discrete being"; the pair here is quoted from this row rather than composed into a new hgm_gloss. gcig alone owns "single" and yin the overt "is".

The compound and numeral members are directly contained and exact. "different projections" is an actual d=3 phrase, preserving rnam pa. All Tibetan syllables are covered; only the second topic marker has no separate lexical exponent. Verse capitals and the compressed "had with" stay verbatim. No new erratum is proposed.

spans.eng: those which will definitely be experienced and those that will not

spans.nul: Continuation of the enumeration; no independent English connective.

segments.note:
PROVISIONAL fresh Codex reconciliation of two independent fresh Codex proposals. The first bar do owns the attested "state between death and rebirth". The second occurrence is retained with its demonstrative as bar do de nyid to "inbetween being himself" at d=3: GMR's shift from the state to its bearer is kept as the contextual phrase, not a dictionary claim that bar do means a person or de nyid independently means a reflexive pronoun. The actual term srid pa bar ma remains the dictionary compound "inbetween beings" with direct members.

The entire coordinated expression myong bar nges ma nges is kept at d=3 as "those which will definitely be experienced and those that will not". Both Tibetan occurrences of nges are therefore represented. The second English predicate is elliptical: in the local classification it can reprise "definitely be experienced" under the negation, while a stronger reading as denial of experience alone would obscure the Tibetan distinction between definite and indefinite. The alignment preserves that English ambiguity; it neither deletes the second nges nor manufactures an explicit English "indefinite", and does not bank a word-level equation with "not experienced". C05:178 explicitly resumes the eleven definite cases. No factual correction is asserted on the basis of the ellipsis.

gnyis gnyis to "two types each", btsas pa'i gnas skabs to "periods out of the womb", and 'phen pa rnam pa to "different projections" are genuine phrases, outside the dictionary harvest. The single dang supplies the last conjunction in the English list. The first locative na becomes "with" under GMR's question recast; gyi in the womb modifier is expressed as "in". The first existential has no independent word after that finite-verb recast, whereas final yod directly owns "are". Only the verse-number apparatus and punctuation remain uncovered. Eleven periods with two possibilities each agree with the source twenty-two. No wording or hgm_gloss was changed, and no new erratum is proposed.
